recon.notes: Platform confirmed as a Squarespace events collection by a working endpoint (/rsvp?format=json → collection.typeName "events", upcoming[] / past[] / pagination{}). The venue runs two rooms with separate addresses published per event: "3 Dollar Bill" (also "3 Dollar Bill YARD") at 260 Meserole Street and "9 Bob Note" (also "The Yard @ 9 Bob Note") at 270 Meserole St[reet]. Epoch-ms feed times were converted to America/New_York; the rendered listing shows the same wall-clock times (e.g. "7:00 PM" / "19:00"). Squarespace URL date segments are creation dates, not event dates (5 rows differ). No row has an excerpt; 10 rows have body text, the rest are a flyer plus a ticket button.

coverage.basis: Feed door /rsvp?format=json returned upcoming[] = 52 rows with no upcoming pagination (Squarespace serves the whole upcoming set; only past[] pages). Second door, the server-rendered /rsvp listing (the configured URL), shows exactly 52 cards in .eventlist--upcoming with titles matching the feed 1:1 in order — zero delta. All 52 event pages were fetched and their JSON-LD start/end times agree with the feed epoch values. Every one of the 52 is a distinct dated Squarespace item with its own URL; the site states no recurrence rule anywhere in page text (the Have Not Room flyer says "THURSDAYS" but each Thursday is published separately), so publishedEventCount = 52 singles, no series. Past listings: the same feed pages a past archive of 1449 distinct items (2246 rows over 75 overlapping pages, back to 2021-04-17), and the listing page itself renders the first 30 past items under the upcoming list — counted, not enumerated. Sitemap cross-check found no 2026-09+ event URL absent from the feed. 52 flyers read: none carries an event that is not already a feed row. Location: the feed publishes marker coordinates per event, so `location` is filled from markerLat/markerLng (defaults = the 260 Meserole marker; 9 Bob Note rows carry 40.708456, -73.9377301 or a slightly different pair the site itself varies).

traps.label: View Event → (link at the foot of every listing card)
traps.why: Each of the 82 cards on /rsvp ends with a "View Event →" anchor pointing at the event page. It is a link label, not a title; the AI extractor in run 20260909-072307 emitted SIX events titled literally "View Event →" (dates 2026-08-04, 09-04, 09-07, 10-06, 10-07, 11-05 — none of which matches any feed row, i.e. the dates were fabricated too). Card titles are the h1.eventlist-title-link text; the same page also puts "Google Calendar", "ICS" and "(map)" links on every card.

traps.label: The 30 past events rendered under the upcoming list (.eventlist--past, no heading)
traps.why: The configured /rsvp page renders page 1 of the past archive (30 cards, Aug 15 – Sep 8 on the recon date) directly below the 52 upcoming cards with no visible "Past" heading — only a CSS class separates them. Run 20260909-072307 kept "UNSPEAKABLE JOY" (Aug 29) and "Live Band Burlesque: Hot Gay Summer Tour" (Aug 13) and bear-dropped KINGDOM HEARTS RAVE, BINY, the Citi Bike launch party and four August Have Not Room Thursdays from this section. The global config sets allowPastEvents: true, so extracting them is correct behaviour, not a bug; they are simply not enumerated here.

traps.label: BROOKLYN'S PREMIERE QUEER NIGHTCLUB, LIVE MUSIC & PERFORMANCE VENUE / 260 Meserole Street / 7183663031 + LocalBusiness openingHours
traps.why: The listing page opens with the venue blurb, address, phone and an intro paragraph, and its JSON-LD LocalBusiness block publishes openingHours "Mo 15:00-00:00, … Su 15:00-00:00". None of it is an event; a segmenter that treats the header as a card would produce a venue-named, time-bearing non-event at 260 Meserole Street.

evidence.quote: BROOKLYN'S PREMIERE QUEER NIGHTCLUB, LIVE MUSIC & PERFORMANCE VENUE

traps.label: INFERNO Sep 17 and Sep 18 pages share one body that names both dates
traps.why: Both INFERNO items (rows 11 and 14) carry the identical description "SEPTEMBER 17TH, 8PM. SEPTEMBER 18TH. 8PM. DOORS AT 7:30." and the same flyer; only the ticket button label differs ("SEPT 17 TICKETS" vs "SEPT 18 TICKETS"). A text-driven extractor reading either page can emit BOTH nights from one page, yielding a duplicate of the other night (or a Sep 17 event carrying the Sep 18 ticket link). Expected: exactly one event per page, dated from the structured startDate.

traps.label: Bear Tea: "DATE CHANGE: Originally 9/12 and moved to 10/3"
traps.why: The Bear Tea page/body states the ORIGINAL date 9/12 alongside the move; the item URL is still /rsvp/2026/9/12/bear-tea and the flyer asset is named BEARTEA+SEP12.png. Anything that trusts the URL date, the flyer filename or the first date in the text will produce a phantom Sep 12 Bear Tea. The published startDate is Sat 2026-10-03 16:00 (run 20260909-072307 got this right).

evidence.quote: DATE CHANGE: Originally 9/12 and moved to 10/3

traps.label: Euphoria Expo flyer still reads "AUGUST 29TH 12PM-7:30PM"
traps.why: The event was moved: the Squarespace item is dated Sun 2026-11-22 12:00–19:30 but the URL segment (/rsvp/2026/8/29/) and the flyer text both carry the original Aug 29 date. An OCR pass that prefers the flyer date would emit a past (Aug 29) Euphoria Expo instead of, or in addition to, the Nov 22 one.

traps.label: JIMBO + PLANE JANE'S SLUT BALL flyer: "OCT 11 THE SINCLAIR BOSTON"
traps.why: The tour flyer lists two stops — "OCT 9 3 DOLLAR BILL BROOKLYN" and "OCT 11 THE SINCLAIR BOSTON". Only the Oct 9 Brooklyn date is a 3 Dollar Bill event; the Boston date is another venue in another city and must not become an nyc event (or any event) from this source.

traps.label: mistr.com sponsor banner link on every event page
traps.why: Every event page (and several flyers, e.g. Dolly Disco, XCX, Nymphia) carries a "mistr" sponsor badge linking to https://mistr.com/?utm_source=inbox&utm_medium=covered&utm_campaign=VENUES. It is an advertiser link, not a ticket or event link; it must not be picked up as ticketUrl/website.

traps.label: /rsvp?offset=<ms> past-archive pages (1449 distinct past events back to 2021)
traps.why: The past archive is reachable only through pagination links the configured URL does not follow (urlDiscoveryDepth not set; the scraper reads /rsvp once). It holds 1449 distinct past items (2246 rows over 75 overlapping pages). They are real past events, not missing upcoming events; nothing from beyond page 1 should appear in a run.

openQuestions.q: A "The Have Not Room: A Big Brother Watch Party" for Thu 2026-09-24 (23:00Z) was in run 20260909-072307 (bearDroppedEvents) and the sitemap still lists /rsvp/2026/7/16/the-have-not-room-a-big-brother-watch-party-edmf7-mht7a-fbzd8 (lastmod 2026-08-21), but on 2026-09-10 that URL returns 404 and the feed has no Sep 24 row. Was it unpublished on purpose (finale moved to Oct 1) — i.e. should the comparison treat a Sep 24 row in a later run as stale rather than missing?

The site is self-inconsistent about rooms: the FINALE (row 29) says "3 Dollar Bill" with the 270 Meserole address, GraveSTONED (row 38) says 3 Dollar Bill/260 in the feed but 9 Bob Note/270 on the flyer, BIG SISTER says "THE YARD @ 3DB" on the flyer. Which should the bar field prefer when the feed location and the flyer disagree — the structured per-event location (used here) or the flyer?
BE BETTER (row 42) publishes endDate 2026-11-16 21:30 for an Oct 17 19:00 event. Documented as published; should a month-long span be flagged as a site data error rather than written to the calendar?
